summary_en: AIAI Group Corporation modified its dividend policy and announced an initial dividend of 15 yen per share for the fiscal year ending March 2027. The company had previously retained all earnings for business expansion and financial strengthening. Going forward, the company targets 15 yen per share annually (7.5 yen each at interim and year-end) linked to earnings performance.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Initial Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
AIAI Group Corporation's Board of Directors approved a fundamental change to dividend policy on October 30, 2026, and announced an initial dividend for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company had not paid any dividend since its establishment, prioritizing internal retained earnings for capital expenditure, development of new business formats, and financial strengthening during its expansion phase.

The company has now determined that, given sustained business growth and improved profitability, it can implement shareholder distributions while continuing necessary investments for sustainable growth and financial stability. The Board revised the dividend forecast and plans to pay an initial dividend of 15 yen per share as a year-end dividend for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. From the fiscal year ending March 31, 2028 onwards, the company targets an annual dividend of 15 yen per share (7.5 yen at both interim and year-end settlements) as a guideline, with dividend levels linked to earnings performance to ensure stable and continuing shareholder returns.
